none: PAS LIN-52DA24: LIN-52DA24: Roman coin of Tetricus I, radiate
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP C TET]RICVS P F AVG ; R/ VIRTVS AV[GG]

A worn copper-alloy contemporary copy of a radiate of Tetricus I dating to the period AD 260-274 (Reece Period 13). VIRTVS AVGG reverse type depicting Virtus standing left with spear and shield. Uncertain mint. RIC, Vol V, no. 148. Obverse description: Radiate bust facing right. Obverse inscription: [IMP C TET]RICVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Virtus standing left with spear and shield. Reverse inscription: VIRTVS AV[GG]. Diameter: 19.89 mm; Thickness: 1.82 mm; Weight: 3.13g
